title: Reconcile existing bounded cognition with canonical dispatch and Hands context
problem: Cognition serving and mandatory verification lack a shared enclosing horizon/grant projection across the three retained contracts.
baseline: Native-qualified Cortex/Hands/Body convergence at ec1ab65; #145 budget implementation exists on a separate lineage.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Reuse #145 ThinkingBudget; add an immutable window to existing InvocationContext while preserving Hands fields; narrow serving only.
advantages: No third Cortex or authority store.
disadvantages: Selective reuse requires contract parity tests.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Replace all wrappers and InvocationContext from #145.
advantages: Includes its budget, routing and recovery mechanisms.
disadvantages: Drops Hands mission/authority/grant fields and Cortex/legacy receipt compatibility.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Reconciled contracts and passing cross-lineage tests.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Keep extracted numeric replacements on the dedicated draft convergence branch.
advantages: No deployment or main merge; original branches preserved.
disadvantages: Local tests cannot prove actual founder or external outcomes.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Current experiment; production remains founder reserved.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Separate child invocations can each receive a fresh ceiling and cognition does not expose current grant deadline pointers.

roles.position: Preserve full-machine destination; this is an enabling control, not full autonomous goal closure. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: No global stopping at budget milestone.

roles.position: Keep one AuthorityOffice, immutable limit projection and existing context fields across all three request paths. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: A projection must never be treated as a grant.

roles.position: Attack caller overrides, deadline exhaustion, model retries, optional authority and forged receipts. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
Preserve signed inputs and historical receipts; shared child ceilings never replenish. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not break old frozen evidence.

roles.position: Distinguish declared compute ceilings, local model attempts and unmeasured actual compute; optional advice never executes. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Unknown actual resource use is not zero.

evidence.claim: Budget reserve, invocation pointers and Cortex compatibility
evidence.reference: 53 focused checks passed before additional integrity and legacy regression checks
evidence.finding: Local fixture and signed test-key evidence; no real founder device or provider outcome.

counterevidence.finding: Its context replacement would discard Hands mission/grant fields; source extraction alone also left the strict receipt field set rejecting additive metadata.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Cognition spends only its enclosing immutable window, preserves a verification reserve and never authorizes optional work.

advantages.statement: Reuse existing budget mechanism rather than a new scheduler.
advantages.amplified_value: Same Kernel dispatch, receipt and learning plane; no authority growth.

disadvantages.statement: Wrapper replacement discards existing Hands context.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Add cognition_budget without removing mission_id, authority_ref, grant_id, policy_version or stop_check.

disadvantages.statement: Serving limits could rewrite signed problem identity.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep original input digest/geometry; disclose only narrowed serving ceilings.

disadvantages.statement: Additive metadata could invalidate retained receipts or permit arbitrary fields.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Permit exactly known optional dataclass fields; preserve digest and authority checks.

disadvantages.statement: Child compositions replenish ceilings or optional estimates become permission.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Shared monotonic deadline and allocated compute ceiling; advisory execute=false with no supported edge.

disadvantages.statement: Migration could regress sealed legacy evaluation or turn unmeasured cost into zero.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep frozen evaluate_problem unchanged; disclose unknown actual compute and worker-reported model attempts.

comparisons.baseline: Separate mechanism exists but not reconciled with Hands.
comparisons.do_nothing: Enclosing deadline and shared child limits remain missing.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Reuse #145 ThinkingBudget; add an immutable window to existing InvocationContext while preserving Hands fields; narrow serving only.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Replace all wrappers and InvocationContext from #145.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Dedicated development branch and signed test-key missions; no deployment.

rejected_alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Loses retained request/receipt contracts and execution context.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Contract reconciliation with all current tests passing.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack authority drift, provider dependence, retries, false measurement, hidden founder attention, timeout/refusal relabeling, complexity and receipt compatibility.

new_weaknesses.statement: A policy refusal at deadline can become a timeout and invite rerouting.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Typed Refusal remains POLICY_REFUSAL; no retry and optional recommendations stop.

new_weaknesses.statement: A fresh-process verifier may exceed remaining wall time.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Separate bounded verifier receives remaining deadline; output is unknown/refused if deadline is exhausted.

new_weaknesses.statement: Declared operation ceilings are not observed actual resource spend.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Actual compute remains unknown; optional allocations are conservative quota reservations, not measured charges.

new_weaknesses.statement: Three contracts could grow three policy or learning systems.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: One budget helper and office projection, existing contract adapters and canonical receipt/settlement owners.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Add cognition_budget without removing mission_id, authority_ref, grant_id, policy_version or stop_check.
Keep original input digest/geometry; disclose only narrowed serving ceilings.
Permit exactly known optional dataclass fields; preserve digest and authority checks.
Shared monotonic deadline and allocated compute ceiling; advisory execute=false with no supported edge.
Keep frozen evaluate_problem unchanged; disclose unknown actual compute and worker-reported model attempts.

pass_2.final_design: Extract eleven bounded solvers and source checks from #145 into greg.cognition; preserve #143 Cortex contracts, seed compatibility, capability state and authority. Version the replacements and source-check evaluator, protect evidence standards from generated-worker edits, and challenge them before draft promotion.

residual_risks.risk: Compute and model-call observations remain incomplete.
residual_risks.mitigation: Ceilings, reported attempts and unknown actual work are separately disclosed.

residual_risks.risk: No independent human approval or broad competence evaluation.
residual_risks.mitigation: Draft only; preserve local evidence tiers and frozen comparisons.

pass_2.strengthened_proposal: Retain existing limits and request contracts, reuse upstream budget helper, protect enforcement, independently verify numeric work, preserve historical receipts and actual dispatch pointers.

dissent.handling: Preserve limitations and unfinished obligations, not artificial consensus.

entries.position: Budget integration does not provide arbitrary natural-language Mind-to-Hands planning.
entries.rationale: Dynamic WorkOrder selection, business closure and founder-device proof remain.
entries.evidence_threshold: End-to-end canonical integration and evidence at each required tier.

migration_plan: Selective upstream reuse; one context and optional additive receipt fields; preserve signed inputs, frozen seed evaluator and existing registry states.

steps: Revert budget reconciliation commit; preserve upstream lineages and historical receipts.

kill_criteria: Generated authority or real-world validity inferred from mathematical results.
A new rival registry or authority path appears.
decision_owner: GREG maintainers for reversible development; Alfonso for reserved promotion
review_trigger: Whole-suite evidence, CI confinement and subsequent dynamic WorkOrder planning.
